description: Screenshots one device, or every device in the extension's simulator tab (uses your real browser session, so signed-in pages work). mode 'device' includes the bezel and stand, 'screen' is the whole display with status bar and browser UI, 'viewport' is only the web page; 'device' and 'screen' have a transparent background. The tab is brought to the front while capturing. For screenshots without a browser window, use view_sim_headless_screenshot.

device.description: Card index (0 = leftmost) or device id. Omit to capture every device.

max_width.description: Images wider than this are scaled down

save_dir.description: Also write the PNGs to this directory and return their paths

tab_id.description: Browser tab id from view_sim_status. Defaults to the focused simulator tab.

name: view_sim_screenshot
title: Screenshot devices
